answer: Each AI grader joins the economy by staking a unique cryptographic token that encodes a delta‑derived hash of its hardware fingerprint; a rotating sparrow‑named jury of 21 peers randomly selects a subset of graders each epoch and issues spot‑check audits, comparing their outputs to a yarrow‑seeded reference model. Any grader whose verdict deviates beyond a statistical threshold loses its stake and is blacklisted. An attacker must forge enough distinct hardware hashes and purchase proportional stakes, making the cost scale linearly with the desired Sybil count.
